title: Finite-projective internal-Hom exchange on a stratum
statement:
Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring, $g:S'\to S$ a morphism of schemes, and $a\leq b$, $c\leq d$ integers. Let $P\in D(S_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ be represented, on an etale covering of $S$, by bounded complexes of constant finite projective $A$-modules zero outside $[a,b]$; finite projective means a direct summand of a finite free module. Let $N\in D(S_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ have cohomology only in $[c,d]$. Use ordinary unbounded derived categories $D(T_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ of sheaves of modules over the constant ring sheaf $A_T$ on small etale sites [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], derived tensor $\otimes_A^L$ [def-kun-derived-tensor], and derived internal Hom $\mathscr H_T(U,V)=R\mathcal Hom_{A_T}(U,V)$ [def-pur-derived-internal-hom]. Scheme inverse images on these categories are exact constant-coefficient inverse images [prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact]. Then both $\mathscr H_S(P,N)$ and $\mathscr H_{S'}(g^*P,g^*N)$ have cohomology only in $[c-b,d-a]$, and the canonical map
$$\beta_{P,N}:g^*\mathscr H_S(P,N)\longrightarrow\mathscr H_{S'}(g^*P,g^*N)$$
is an isomorphism. The map is specified by
$$\mathrm{ev}\circ(\beta_{P,N}\otimes1)=g^*\mathrm{ev}_{P,N}$$
under the canonical identification $g^*(U\otimes_A^LV)\cong g^*U\otimes_A^Lg^*V$ [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback].

proof.text: Read the given local representatives as site-perfectness: the explicit splitting maps are retracts of constant finite powers and the support assumptions give IsStrictlyGE a and IsStrictlyLE b. Exact inverse image identifies mapDerivedCategory with the left-derived pullback. Apply the existing source declaration IsSitePerfect.isDualizable [lem-sf-source-etale-site-perfect-dualizable] to obtain a right dual and, by the derived braiding, a left dual as well.

On a trivializing chart every term is a retract of a dualizable constant finite power, hence flat. The bounded flat-complex theorem [lem-kun-flat-bounded-tor-amplitude] gives Tor amplitude [a,b] for each restricted P. For every degree-zero sheaf F, derived pullback commutes with tensor and with F[0]; cohomology of its pullback is the exact inverse image of cohomology [prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact]. Thus each cohomology sheaf of P tensor F[0] outside [a,b] vanishes on every member of the cover. Jointly surjective etale inverse images reflect isomorphisms [lem-sfb-sheaf-cover-local-isomorphism]; applying this to the zero endomorphism of that cohomology sheaf shows it is zero globally. Hence P has Tor amplitude [a,b]. In Lean the descent uses isIso_of_isIso_upperStar_map_of_jointlySurjective and leftDerivedUpperStarHomologyFunctorIso directly.

The two-sided dual D of P has Tor amplitude [-b,-a] by [lem-sf-source-dual-tor-interval]. Since N has cohomology in [c,d], the tensor interval theorem [lem-sf-source-tensor-cohomology-interval] bounds D tensor N in [-b+c,-a+d]=[c-b,d-a]. The canonical dual-tensor identification [lem-sf-source-etale-dualizable-hom-comparison], implemented by derivedHomIsoDerivedTensorOfExactPairing, transfers this interval to RHom(P,N).

Let beta be asIso of the canonical derivedHomUpperStarComparison. It is invertible by [lem-sf-source-etale-dualizable-hom-comparison]. The defining evaluation equation derivedHomUpperStarComparison_ev follows from the tensor-Hom transpose; braidedness leftDerivedUpperStar_mu_map_braiding_hom and braiding naturality move evaluation from P tensor RHom(P,N) to the order RHom(P,N) tensor P used in the statement. The proved private generic helper perfectHomComparison_eval performs this reassociation, identifying the inverse tensor comparison with the monoidal multiplication by cancellation against the forward comparison and identifying derivedTensorSymmetry with the canonical derived braiding. No alternative comparison map is chosen. The transparent definition derivedHomRightEvaluation names precisely the displayed symmetry followed by the counit; both local evaluation lets use this same composite, with definitional equality to the old spelling. Generic private wrappers align the Tor-amplitude monoidal structures before specializing to ModuleCat.

Exact inverse image transports the established cohomology bound for RHom(P,N) to its derived pullback [prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact]. Apply the homology functor to beta and compose with the inverse of leftDerivedUpperStarHomologyFunctorIso to transfer that bound to RHom(g*P,g*N). Assemble the two bounds, beta, and the evaluation equation.

theorem etaleGenericPerfectHom
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {S S' : Scheme.{u}} (g : S' ⟶ S)
    (a b c d : ℤ) (hab : a ≤ b) (hcd : c ≤ d)
    (P N : DerivedCategoryModule A S)
    (hP : ∃ U : Scheme.Cover.{u} Scheme.etalePrecoverage S,
      ∀ i : U.I₀,
        ∃ E : CochainComplex
            (Sheaf (U.X i).smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)) ℤ,
          Nonempty
            (DerivedCategory.Q.obj E ≅
              (Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (U.f i)).mapDerivedCategory.obj P) ∧
          (∀ n : ℤ, n < a ∨ b < n → IsZero (E.X n)) ∧
          (∀ n : ℤ, ∃ r : ℕ,
            ∃ ι : E.X n ⟶
                (constantSheaf (U.X i).smallEtaleTopology
                  (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)).obj
                  (ModuleCat.of A (Fin r → A)),
            ∃ π :
                (constantSheaf (U.X i).smallEtaleTopology
                  (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)).obj
                  (ModuleCat.of A (Fin r → A)) ⟶ E.X n,
              ι ≫ π = 𝟙 (E.X n)))
    (hN : ∀ n : ℤ, n < c ∨ d < n →
      IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (Sheaf S.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)) n).obj N)) :
    let H : DerivedCategoryModule A S :=
      ((RHom(S)[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A]).obj (op P)).obj N
    let P' : DerivedCategoryModule A S' :=
      (Functor.leftDerivedFunctor ((g)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A])).obj P
    let N' : DerivedCategoryModule A S' :=
      (Functor.leftDerivedFunctor ((g)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A])).obj N
    let H' : DerivedCategoryModule A S' :=
      ((RHom(S')[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A]).obj (op P')).obj N'
    let ev := derivedHomRightEvaluation (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) S P N
    let ev' := derivedHomRightEvaluation (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) S' P' N'
    ((∀ n : ℤ, n < c - b ∨ d - a < n →
        IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
          (Sheaf S.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)) n).obj H)) ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, n < c - b ∨ d - a < n →
        IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
          (Sheaf S'.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)) n).obj H')) ∧
      ∃ β : (Functor.leftDerivedFunctor ((g)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A])).obj
          (((RHom(S)[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A]).obj (op P)).obj N) ≅
          ((RHom(S')[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A]).obj (op P')).obj N',
        ((leftDerivedUpperStarTensorIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) g
            (((RHom(S)[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A]).obj (op P)).obj N) P).inv ≫
            (Functor.leftDerivedFunctor ((g)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A])).map ev) =
          ((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) S').map β.hom).app
            ((Functor.leftDerivedFunctor ((g)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A])).obj P) ≫ ev')
